seo__browser_title: AA & GA Meetings — Oakdene House Foundation
seo__search_description: Alcoholics Anonymous and Gamblers Anonymous meetings at Oakdene House, Fairfield — including Spanish-speaking sessions. Free and open to all.
hero__intro: Alcoholics Anonymous and Gamblers Anonymous meetings at Oakdene House.
overview__heading: A space for recovery and connection
overview__text: We provide a safe, supportive space for people in recovery. Meetings are facilitated by experienced members and follow AA and GA traditions.
overview__text_2: If you'd like to reach AA or GA directly — outside our meeting times, or before coming along — you can contact them here:
overview__text_4: See the full schedule of meetings below. New members are welcome and walk-ins are accepted.
about_aa_and_ga__text: AA is a fellowship of people who share their experience, strength and hope with each other to solve their common problem and help others to recover from alcoholism. Membership is open to anyone with a desire to stop drinking.
about_aa_and_ga__text_2: We host both English and Spanish-speaking AA meetings at Oakdene.
about_aa_and_ga__text_3: GA is a fellowship of people who share their experience, strength and hope with each other so they may solve their common problem and help others to recover from a gambling problem.
about_aa_and_ga__text_4: GA meetings provide a structured peer environment built on the 12-step model of recovery.
meeting_schedule__intro: New members are welcome and walk-ins are accepted. Meetings run weekly except where noted.
data__what_to_expect: A confidential space focused on recovery and accountability
